verdict.rationale: cubic supports on-demand triggering via PR comments (@cubic-dev-ai review this PR) and cubic.yaml configuration for review behavior and ignore patterns, plus custom agents/rules. However, there is no explicit evidence of skipping draft PRs, filtering by branch, or filtering by label/tags — these specific controls are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit draft-PR skip option, branch filtering, label-based filtering, and any UI/config toggle for these controls.
